newsitem.title: USA: Amcore, Country Bank modify merger terms.
newsitem.headline: Amcore, Country Bank modify merger terms.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Friday it and Country Bank Shares Corp have revised the financial terms of their merger agreement, removing uncertainty regarding the closing of the deal.
Amcore said it agreed to an exchange ratio of 4.3267 shares for each Country share if Amcore's average stock price ranges from $19.50 to $24.50.
If the average price is $24.50 to $28.50, each Country share will be exchanged for the number of shares required to maintain an aggregate value of $46.6 million for Country.
If Amcore's average stock price is greater than $28.50, each Country share will be exchanged into 3.7194 shares of Amcore common stock.
If Amcore's average stock price is greater than $15 but less than $19.50, each Country share will be exchanged for the number of shares required for an aggregate value of $37.1 million.
If the average stock price is below $15, each Country share will be exchanged into 5.6247 shares of Amcore.

The Amcore average stock price will be determined by calculating the average daily Amcore closing prices during the 20 trading days ending three days before the Country shareholder meeting. Country Bank Shares has 439,699 shares outstanding, Amcore said.

"The amended merger agreement removes a great deal of uncertainty regarding the closing of the transaction," Robert Meuleman, president and chief executive of Amcore, said in a statement. "We believe that these terms create a favorable outcome for both parties, especially in light of Amcore's recent stock performance," he said.
Amcore said when it began negotiating the merger, its stock was trading at about $20.50 a share. On Friday it closed at $27.50.
"There has clearly been a significant run-up in the stock price since we first set the exchange ratio," John Hecht, chief financial officer, said.
In January, Amcore said the companies signed a definitive agreement under which each Country Bank share would have been exchanged for 4.3267 shares of Amcore.
At that time it also signed a termination agreement, which has been eliminated.
The termination agreement said if Amcore common stock exceeded $24 a share, Amcore could terminate the transaction unless Country accepted a lower ration to fix the maximum value at $45.6 million.

And under the termination agreement, Country could have terminated the transaction if Amcore's stock fell below $19 a share, unless Amcore accepted a higher exchange ratio to fix the minimum value at about $36.2 million.
Amcore has more than $3 billion in assets, and six subsidiary banks operating in 41 locations. Country has assets of more than $300 million.
